claims: U.S. stock markets including the NYSE and Nasdaq are closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
Bond markets close early at 12 p.m. ET on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
U.S. stock market trading resumes on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The London Stock Exchange is closed on Good Friday 2026.
Euronext Paris is closed on Good Friday 2026.
Crypto markets are open on Good Friday 2026.
Most major banks are open as normal on Good Friday 2026.
The USPS is open on Good Friday 2026.
The USPS provides regular mail delivery on Good Friday 2026.
Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
Many state government offices are closed on Good Friday 2026.
Many schools are closed on Good Friday 2026.
The day after Thanksgiving is November 27, 2026.
The trading session for November 27, 2026 will close early at 1 p.m. ET.
